entities.summary: Brandon Eric Guyer is an American former professional baseball outfielder and mental strength coach for the Los Angeles Angels and the University of Virginia Cavaliers Baseball team. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Tampa Bay Rays and Cleveland Indians. His knack for getting hit by pitches earned him the nickname, "La Piñata."
